sections.label: Miscellaneous amendments across Acts
sections.summary: It makes miscellaneous amendments across a number of Acts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: It makes miscellaneous amendments across a number of Acts.

sections.label: Definition of repeal amended
sections.summary: The non-exhaustive definition of "repeal" will be amended to clarify that it includes "delete".

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: First, the non-exhaustive definition of "repeal" will be amended to clarify that it includes "delete", which is a term that is used in amending legislation.

sections.label: Air Navigation Act insurance regulations
sections.summary: Clause 3 amends section 9(1) of the Air Navigation Act 1966 to enable CAAS to make certain insurance-related regulations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Next, clause 3 amends section 9(1) of the Air Navigation Act 1966 (ANA) in two ways.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: It will expressly enable the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS) to make certain insurance-related regulations, including regulations necessary to comply with the 1999 Montreal Convention.

sections.label: Copyright Act section 193 amendment
sections.summary: Clause 6(a) amends section 193 of the CA so it also applies to underlying materials in performances fairly used for criticism or review.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Clause 6(a) of the Bill thus amends section 193 of the CA, such that section 193 will also apply to underlying materials in performances that are fairly used for the purposes of criticism or review.

sections.label: PACT determinations issued
sections.summary: Since PACT was set up around two and a half years ago, it has issued about 1,070 determinations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Since PACT was set up around two and a half years ago, it has issued about 1,070 determinations.

sections.label: Assessors and Notification for Relief
sections.summary: Assessors determine whether a Notification for Relief was validly issued; moratorium applications are now moot as the moratorium expired on 28 February 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The assessors' role for such applications is to determine whether a Notification for Relief (NFR) was validly issued to enable a party to seek relief under Part 2 and Part 8.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Applications relating to the availability of the moratorium are now moot, as the moratorium expired on 28 February 2022, together with the expiry of the prescribed period.

sections.label: COTMA Part 2 expiry
sections.summary: Part 2 of COTMA expired at the end of 19 April 2022, but Assessor's Determination applications were allowed until 30 April 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Pursuant to section 1(2A) of COTMA, Part 2 expired at the end of 19 April 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: However, the COTMA regulations permitted applications for an Assessor's Determination in respect of construction and supply contracts to be made up till 30 April 2022.

sections.label: Repeal of MASA and SDA
sections.summary: Clauses 12(2) and (3) of the Bill provide for the repeal of the MASA and SDA in separate sub-sections.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Clauses 12(2) and (3) of this Bill provides for the repeal of the MASA and SDA in separate sub-sections so that they can be repealed separately.

sections.label: Minister's functions under MACMA
sections.summary: Clause 13 amends section 41(5) of MACMA to make clear the Minister's functions may be exercised by an authorised public officer.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Clause 13 of the Bill amends section 41(5) of MACMA to make clear that the Minister's functions under that section may be exercised by a public officer authorised by the Minister.

sections.label: Cash grant crediting period
sections.summary: Clause 14 amends section 16(1)(a) of the PMGFA to enable individuals to receive the cash grant whether crediting is during or after the prescribed period.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Clause 14 of the Bill amends section 16(1)(a) of the PMGFA to enable such individuals to receive the cash grant in respect of the prescribed period, whether the crediting is made during or after that period.

sections.label: Volunteers as public service workers
sections.summary: The Government is identifying classes of volunteers who qualify as public service workers and targets bringing the amendment into force in 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The Government is working to identify the classes of volunteers who qualify as public service workers and target to bring this amendment into force in 2023.

sections.label: Public Utilities Board members increase
sections.summary: Clause 17 amends the Public Utilities Act 2001 to increase the maximum number of Board members from 10 to 13, excluding the Chairperson.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Next, clause 17 of the Bill amends the Public Utilities Act 2001 to increase the maximum number of Board members from 10 to 13, excluding the Chairperson.

sections.label: Disclaimers before 26 May 2022
sections.summary: Clause 18 adds subsection 2A giving legal effect to disclaimers made before 26 May 2022 if filed compliantly with the RDA and rules.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Clause 18 of the Bill therefore introduces a new subsection 2A to provide express legal effect to disclaimers made before 26 May 2022, if it was filed in a manner that was compliant with the RDA and the prevailing rules.

sections.label: Abolishing show cause proceedings
sections.summary: Clause 20 abolishes show cause proceedings in the 15 Acts for a consistent approach to failure to attend Court in criminal proceedings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: To ensure a consistent approach across all criminal proceedings regarding a failure to attend Court, clause 20 of the Bill abolishes the show cause proceedings in the 15 Acts.

sections.label: Correcting references
sections.summary: Clause 21 of the Bill corrects the references.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Clause 21 of the Bill corrects the references.
